study.title: Immediate and sustained effects of acupuncture on the default mode network
study.study_design: Within-subject repeated measures resting-state fMRI study with three scan phases (pre-needle insertion, during needle retention, post-needle removal)
study.population: Healthy participants recruited from the community of Guangzhou
study.inclusion_criteria: Participants were in good physical health, without any acute or chronic illnesses, and right-handed. Furthermore, they were required to have a sound mental state. Self-rating Depression Scale score < 53; Self-rating Anxiety Scale score < 50; Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index score < 6; Beck Depression Inventory score < 14; Both genders were eligible, with ages between 18 and 35; Participants were able to independently complete the questionnaires and sign the informed consent form.
study.exclusion_criteria: Patients clinically diagnosed with depression, previous psychiatric disorders, or organic mental disorders; Individuals with severe diseases affecting the brain, liver, heart, kidneys, hematopoietic system, etc.; Pregnant or lactating women; Individuals taking any medication during the trial; Absolute contraindications for MRI: Individuals with cardiac pacemakers or cardiac metal valves, coronary artery bypass grafts, or vascular metal hemostatic clips; Individuals with implanted or wearable ferromagnetic or electronic devices (such as cochlear implants, dynamic electrocardiograms, cardiac monitors, insulin pumps); Relative contraindications for MRI: Individuals with internal metallic implants (such as artificial joints, fixed steel plates, metal dentures, intrauterine devices); Known alcohol or substance dependence; Currently participating in other clinical trials; Individuals with a history of adverse reactions to acupuncture or known allergies to needle puncture; Individuals with surgical scars, skin infections, skull defects, or any condition affecting the treatment at the acupuncture sites.

arms.dropouts: No withdrawals due to excessive head motion or claustrophobia

interventions.procedure_label_exact: Acupuncture needle stimulation at Baihui (GV20) and Yintang (GV29)
interventions.anatomical_location_exact: GV20: located at the intersection of the midline of the top of the head and the line connecting the tips of the two ears, and the front hairline is 5 inches straight up. GV29: at the midpoint of the line connecting the two eyebrows.
interventions.needle_type_exact: custom-made pure silver acupuncture needle; 0.40mm×25mm silver acupuncture needles produced by Suzhou Medical Supplies Co., Ltd.
interventions.depth_exact: GV20: inserted 0.5-0.8 cun posteriorly; GV29: inserted 0.5-0.8 cun from top to bottom
interventions.manipulation_exact: combination of even reinforcing and reducing techniques, with light to moderate stimulation to produce De Qi sensation (sourness, numbness, distention, and pain). GV20 point was needled directly upward at the midpoint of the anterior hairline, 5 cun in length, and then inserted 0.5-0.8 cun posteriorly. GV29 point was needled by pinching and inserting the needle 0.5-0.8 cun from top to bottom in the middle of the forehead between the eyebrows.
interventions.deqi_intended_exact: Yes; De Qi sensation described as sourness, numbness, distention, and pain, which is considered an effective acupuncture response
interventions.practitioner_description_exact: All procedures were performed by licensed acupuncturists with more than 5 years of experience.
interventions.participant_instructions_exact: Participants were placed in a supine position with the acupuncture site fully exposed. Subjects were instructed to relax, wear special earplugs to reduce noise interference, lie flat on the examination bed in a supine position, and place their hands on their sides naturally.
interventions.treatment_rationale_given_exact: GV20 and GV29 are frequently used as a combination to enhance brain function; GV20 is believed to have a nourishing and tonifying effect on the brain; GV29 acupoint is believed to have the effects of nourishing the brain, replenishing the Yuan Qi (primordial energy), and regulating emotional well-being.

sensory_interoceptive_responses.item_or_subscale_exact: De Qi sensation described as sourness, numbness, distention, and pain
sensory_interoceptive_responses.value_exact: Light to moderate stimulation to produce De Qi (sourness, numbness, distention, and pain), which is considered an effective acupuncture response
sensory_interoceptive_responses.notes: De Qi was described as intended but no quantitative data were reported for sensory responses in this study.

neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: SMS-BOLD sequence; 3D-T1WI sequence also acquired. FLAIR, T2WI, and T1WI sequence scans performed first to rule out brain disorders.
neuroimaging_methods.TR_exact: SMS-BOLD: TR=500ms; 3D-T1WI: TR=2530ms; T1WI: TR=2500ms; T2WI: TR=3650ms; T2FLAIR: TR=9000ms
neuroimaging_methods.TE_exact: SMS-BOLD: TE=30ms; 3D-T1WI: TE=2.98ms; T1WI: TE=24ms; T2WI: TE=92ms; T2FLAIR: TE=120ms
neuroimaging_methods.scan_duration_exact: Each resting-state fMRI phase: 20 minutes; SMS-BOLD scanning time: 8min07s; 3D-T1WI scanning time: 5min58s
neuroimaging_methods.preprocessing_software_exact: MATLAB (for within-network connectivity analysis); SPM version 12 (Statistical Parametric Mapping) (for seed-to-whole-brain FC analysis)
neuroimaging_methods.normalization_template_exact: EPI registration (spatial normalization using EPI registration)
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: 6mm full-width at half maximum kernel (for seed-to-whole-brain FC analysis only; not applied for within-network connectivity analysis)
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: Exclusion criteria included excessive movement during the scanning process leading to the presence of artifacts in the images; head motion correction performed; 24 head motion parameters (Friston 24) regressed out
primary_neuroimaging_metrics: Functional connectivity (FC) within the default mode network (within-network connectivity)

Seed-to-whole-brain FC: FWE correction, cluster level, voxel P < 0.001, cluster P < 0.05

adverse_events.adverse_event_exact: The acupuncture procedure performed by the acupuncturists did not present any issues such as needle breakage, needle retention, needle bending, or needle residue. The participants also did not experience needle-induced fainting, local hematoma, local infection, intolerable needle pain, post-needle pain, fatigue, palpitations, dizziness, headache, insomnia, or other discomfort.

extraction_notes.note: No sham or control acupuncture arm was included in this study. All participants received verum acupuncture at GV20 and GV29. This limits causal inference about neural changes being specific to acupuncture versus non-specific effects.
Expectancy, blinding success, credibility, and allocation guessing measures were not assessed or reported in this study. No sham arm was present.

Quantitative deqi/sensory response data were not formally measured or reported. Only a qualitative description of intended De Qi (sourness, numbness, distention, and pain) was provided in the methods.
The paper does not report individual F-statistics or t-statistics for within-network connectivity repeated measures ANOVA or pairwise t-tests. Only p-values are given.
Trial registration number is not reported in the paper.

The paper refers to GV29 as 'Yintang' and also as 'GV29'. In the WHO standard, Yintang is typically classified as EX-HN3, not GV29. The paper's own labeling (GV29) has been preserved exactly as written throughout this extraction.

The coordinate space is described as MNI based on the MNI coordinates reported in the text for PCC/PCU-Cerebelum_8_L (X=-15, Y=-57, Z=-39) and ANG-Frontal_Sup_Medial_L (X=0, Y=45, Z=8), and the use of SPM12 and EPI normalization template. However, the paper does not explicitly state 'MNI' as the coordinate space name.

The preprocessing pipeline differed between the two analyses: within-network connectivity analysis did NOT include spatial smoothing, while seed-to-whole-brain FC analysis DID include 6mm FWHM smoothing. This distinction is preserved in the neuroimaging_methods section.

The paper does not report the exact F-statistics for the repeated measures ANOVA at the within-network connectivity level or for the seed-to-whole-brain analysis. Only T-values for peak clusters (PCC/PCU: T=14.322; ANG: T=13.343) are given for the FWE-corrected whole-brain results.

Table S1, Table S2, and Table S3 are referenced in the paper and partially reproduced in the supplementary material section of the PDF. Table S1 provides FC values for within-network DMN connectivity; Table S2 provides FC values between seed regions and whole-brain cluster regions; Table S3 provides safety evaluation data. These values have been extracted from the supplementary section of the PDF.

The paper states the FDR correction was applied for within-network connectivity (cluster level, voxel P < 0.001, cluster P < 0.05), but then the results report p-values for pairwise t-tests (e.g., P=0.12, P<0.01, P=0.15) without specifying whether these are corrected or uncorrected. It is unclear whether FDR correction was additionally applied to the pairwise post-hoc comparisons.
The paper does not report BMI, age, or gender statistics for individual comparison or correlation with neural outcomes. Demographic data are reported as group descriptives only (Table 1).

The paper claims to have 'used fMRI for the first time to investigate the immediate and sustained effects of acupuncture.' This is an authors' claim and has not been independently verified. It is preserved for informational purposes only.
The paper does not report whether participants had prior acupuncture experience, which may influence their sensory responses and neural activity during the experiment.

The study uses a single-arm within-subject design with three scan phases. There is no randomization of the order of conditions (needle insertion always followed baseline scan, and needle removal always followed needle-in-place scan). Order effects cannot be ruled out.
The paper reports that no significant results survived FWE correction for the mPFC seed-to-whole-brain analysis but does not report the uncorrected trends or regions that approached significance.
